sampling.rule: Train only: hash-order fixed Unicode-character chunks; exact equal character budget prose/poetry, cap=min(available domains,limit). Last chunk may be cropped. UTF8 byte counts reported separately. SFT message content naturally once, no duplication.

policy.selection: 4k diagnostic. Default new8k;16k only if mean of domain-wise prose/poetry token savings vs8k>=15%, neither pretrain domain nor SFT worsens and SFT fits512. Replace v2 only if chosen candidate strictly improves prose validation tokens, poetry<=+1%, SFT<=+1%, all train/validation SFT fits512. Otherwise retain v2. No automatic test-driven fallback.
policy.test_use: Read/evaluate only after selection is persisted; selected tokenizer only; never tune on test.
policy.reason: Predeclared compression/embedding-cost heuristic, not evidence of generation quality or statistical significance.

limitations: Compression does not measure downstream language/generation quality.
RSS is sampled whole-process memory, not isolated allocator maximum.
Fixed character chunks introduce artificial fit boundaries; evaluation uses full original works.
No normalization: historical orthography and whitespace preserved.
Test overlength is reported without changing tokenizer selection or silently truncating.
